title: Check commit json prints the outcome
description: check commit json prints the outcome
no_spec_change_rationale: the --json path must answer with one document (REQ-change-004: equivalent human and machine workflows; cli invariant 5: --json switches all output to JSON) — the commit path printing nothing was the bug
acceptance_criteria: change check --commit --json prints one JSON document with the change id, both commit ids, pushed and left_out; a refusal prints the JSON error document with a non-zero exit
